Problem.description: An RFC 9457 Problem Details object. code is one of: 401 unauthenticated; 403 access_denied; 404 not_found; 409 conflict; 422 validation_error; 422 user_error; 4xx invalid_request; 500 internal_error. See /docs/api/errors for what each means.

Context.description: Context for the call, such as lang, tz and allowed_company_ids.

instance.description: An opaque id for this occurrence; present on 5xx only.

type.description: A reference to the error code's entry on /docs/api/errors.

Ids.description: Record ids the method is called on.

user_raw_script_answer_id.description: Id of the script answer. Useful for statistics when answer is deleted.
user_raw_script_answer_id.title: User Raw Script Answer

redirect_link.description: The visitor will be redirected to this link upon clicking the option (note that the script will end if the link is external to the livechat website).
redirect_link.title: Redirect Link

crm_team_id.description: Used in combination with 'create_lead' step type in order to automatically assign the created lead/opportunity to the defined team
crm_team_id.title: Sales Team

operator_expertise_ids.description: When forwarding live chat conversations, the chatbot will prioritize users with matching expertise.
operator_expertise_ids.title: Operator Expertise

triggering_answer_ids.description: Show this step only if all of these answers have been selected.
triggering_answer_ids.title: Only If

block_assignment_during_call.description: While on a call, agents will not receive new conversations.
block_assignment_during_call.title: No Chats During Call

button_background_color.description: Default background color of the Livechat button
button_background_color.title: Button Background Color

button_text_color.description: Default text color of the Livechat button
button_text_color.title: Button Text Color

default_message.description: This is an automated 'welcome' message that your visitor will see when they initiate a new conversation.
default_message.title: Welcome Message

header_background_color.description: Default background color of the channel header once open
header_background_color.title: Header Background Color

max_sessions.description: Maximum number of concurrent sessions per operator.
max_sessions.title: Maximum Sessions

max_sessions_mode.description: If limited, operators will only handle the selected number of sessions at a time.
max_sessions_mode.title: Sessions per Operator

review_link.description: Visitors who leave a positive review will be redirected to this optional link.
review_link.title: Review Link

title_color.description: Default title color of the channel once open
title_color.title: Title Color

web_page.description: URL to a static page where you client can discuss with the operator of the channel.
web_page.title: Web Page

session_country_id.description: Country of the visitor of the channel
session_country_id.title: Country

session_duration_hour.description: Time spent by the persona in the session in hours
session_duration_hour.title: Session Duration

action.description:
* 'Show' displays the chat button on the pages.
* 'Show with notification' is 'Show' in addition to a floating text just next to the button.
* 'Open automatically' displays the button and automatically opens the conversation pane on larger screens. On small screens, this behaves like 'Show'.
* 'Hide' hides the chat button on the pages.
action.title: Live Chat Button

auto_popup_timer.description: Delay (in seconds) to automatically open the conversation window. Note: the selected action must be 'Open automatically' otherwise this parameter will not be taken into account.
auto_popup_timer.title: Time to Open

chatbot_enabled_condition.title: Enable ChatBot
x-enum-labels: Only when no operator is available
Only when an operator is available

country_ids.description: The rule will only be applied for these countries. Example: if you select 'Belgium' and 'United States' and that you set the action to 'Hide', the chat button will be hidden on the specified URL from the visitors located in these 2 countries. This feature requires GeoIP installed on your server.
country_ids.title: Countries

regex_url.description: Regular expression specifying the web pages this rule will be applied on.
regex_url.title: URL Regex

sequence.description: Given the order to find a matching rule. If 2 rules are matching for the given url/country, the one with the lowest sequence will be chosen.
sequence.title: Matching order

has_call.title: Whether the session had a call

lang_id.description: Lang of the visitor of the channel.
lang_id.title: Language

nbr_message.description: Number of message in the conversation
nbr_message.title: Messages per Session

start_date_hour.title: Hour of start Date of session

start_date_minutes.title: Start Date of session, truncated to minutes

time_to_answer.description: Average time in hours to give the first answer to the visitor
time_to_answer.title: Response Time

is_internal.description: Hide to public / portal users, independently from subtype configuration.
is_internal.title: Visible Internally Only

ab_testing_schedule_datetime.description: Date that will be used to know when to determine and send the winner mailing
ab_testing_schedule_datetime.title: Send Final On

ab_testing_winner_selection.description: Selection to determine the winner mailing that will be sent.
ab_testing_winner_selection.title: Winner Selection

click_count.title: Number of clicks generated by the campaign

is_auto_campaign.description: Allows us to filter relevant Campaigns
is_auto_campaign.title: Automatically Generated Campaign

color.description: Tag color. No color means no display in kanban to distinguish internal tags from public categorization tags.
color.title: Color Index

info.description: The published contract for one application area, generated from a fresh installation as the administrator on default settings; fields behind optional feature groups are not listed. Every model and method is reachable over POST /json/2/<model>/<method>.
info.title: AFENDA xForge JSON API
